item.title: How William Forrester Jr. grew a Richmond baseball legacy
item.description: William Forrester Jr., who spent decades working to create opportunities for generations of young baseball players, will be honored at the RVA Sports Awards this weekend.

item.title: C.C. Wells Elementary lights up with STEAM Night: 'This is so magical'
item.description: Students at C.C. Wells Elementary School in Chester got a chance to explore their creativity and curiosity at the school's STEAM Night on Thursday.

item.title: Richmond's new transportation director outlines plan to address pedestrian safety
item.description: In an interview with CBS 6, Richmond's newly-established director of transportation detailed steps the city is taking to address a surge in pedestrian deaths.
